profile.headline: Software Engineer - Site Reliability Engineer at Google

positions.title: Instructional Associate
positions.description: Instructional Associate for CS 6515: Intro to Graduate Algorithms

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Assist engineering teams in migrating from Google internal infrastructure to GCP through security / cloud consultation and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
- Lead development of group system service used for access control list (ACL) for cloud resources identity and access management (IAM).
- Managed company’s GCP cloud organization through enforcing organizational policies and security best practices.
- Instrumented data pipeline platform (based on Apache Airflow) with monitoring and alerting using GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, and Grafana.
- Added Cloud Dataflow (GCP hosted Apache Beam) plugin to data pipeline platform, including continuous deployment with GitHub Actions, allowing users to process large scale data.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - Business Intelligence Data Platform
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented API endpoints to allow registering metadata for data discovery service
- Architected Cassandra schema for optimized performance given query patterns
- Setup infrastructure and build process for data loader service migration Redshift to Snowflake data warehouse

positions.title: Data Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Optimized and designed Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipeline to bring Salesforce data to S3 datalake with a time improvement of 3x
- Designed schema for efficient Hive and Presto queries
- Created directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) using Apache Airflow to schedule Spark jobs for ETL

positions.title: Process Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Helped drive decisions worth $50M / yr by coordinating research and development (R&D) program across multiple organizational boundaries
- Minimized unit turnaround duration through inventory optimization for margin captured of $2M / turnaround / site
- Analyzed morphology data with regression / neural networks, predicting unwanted outcomes and increasing unit safety
- Provided statistical analysis on unit feed capacity increase feasibility worth $25M with a confidence interval of 95%

positions.title: Process Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Created probability based tool for risk / reward calculations for a margin captured of $2M / yr
- Used process simulation software for case study analysis on project expansion and optimization scenarios

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant - 1300 Intro to Computing
positions.description:
- Performed troubleshooting assistance on data analysis assignments utilizing Excel (VBA) and MATLAB
- Provided guidance for section of 25 students by leading weekly recitations and office hours

positions.title: Process Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Used Aspen HYSYS simulation calculations and in-house software to size lines and vessels 
- Developed engineering workbooks to streamline design practices

positions.title: Undergrad Research Assistant
positions.description: - Synthesized polymer membranes and performed gas separation testing
